name: discussion-grammar-diagnosis
description: Diagnose grammar in the Discussion of an English psychology research paper. Covers tense choice (Present Simple for permanent truths vs Past Simple for study-specific findings), subject-verb agreement, article usage, voice (active vs passive), and punctuation.
author: UX Course Project - Discussion Group

clawhub.theory_basis: Glasman-Deal (2021) Science Research Writing Unit 4.2.2 (tense choice by claim type)
